title: Clothes and Shoes
introduction: Name things we wear in different situations.
definition: Name things we wear in different situations.
rules: Say each word aloud. Look for examples in everyday life.
Practise the sentences with a partner.

vocabulary.description: A casual top with short sleeves.
Outer clothing for the upper body.
A coat that helps keep rain off.

examples.question: Read and say this sentence.
steps: I wear a raincoat when it rains.
examples.answer: I wear a raincoat when it rains.

exercises.question: What do we wear on our head? (hat or socks)
exercises.solution: A hat covers the head; socks cover the feet.

exercises.question: What helps keep rain off?
exercises.solution: A raincoat helps keep your clothes dry in rain.

exercises.question: What covers the feet inside shoes?
exercises.solution: Socks are worn on the feet, often inside shoes.

exercises.question: What is a casual top with short sleeves?
exercises.solution: A T-shirt is a casual top, usually with short sleeves.

exercises.question: What is open footwear?
exercises.solution: Sandals leave parts of the feet uncovered.

exercises.question: What are short trousers called?
exercises.solution: Shorts are trousers with short legs.

summary: Name things we wear in different situations.
